Kavya Rao: Quick follow-up from today's runtime Q&A — logging action items here.
Arjun Mehta: Can you confirm the p95 target and the exact perf profile we should use for benchmarking?
Kavya Rao: Hosted p95 target = 120ms measured at 8k context, steady-state (warmed KV cache), avg request ~512 tokens, default quantized path.
Claire Wu: Will teams get a yaml example for the latency_budget batching heuristic? We hit bad tails when we copied earlier heuristics.
Kavya Rao: Yes — I'll post a copy-paste YAML later today. Short summary: latency-first (stop on latency_budget_ms or max_batch_size) + per-route opt-in throughput mode.
Tomas Rivera: KV cache issue: one customer saw tail spikes when global pressure eviction ran. What's the mitigation plan?
Kavya Rao: Short-term: bump tenant TTLs and lower eviction_pressure threshold. Long-term: switch to per-tenant LRU with a protected recent-prefix segment and expose eviction metrics.
Arjun Mehta: Which metrics will be added for eviction so we can alert?
Kavya Rao: eviction_count, eviction_reason, eviction_ttl_expiry as tags. Runtime team to publish expected baselines.
Claire Wu: Tracing: can we get per-kernel spans (matmul/attention/softmax) exposed in Console? Current spans collapse everything.
Kavya Rao: Runtime will add kernel_name and kernel_ms spans behind a feature flag next sprint.
sre-oncall: Hotpatch safety question: a partial hotpatch left some ops hung during canary. Who should receive trace ids?
Tomas Rivera: Tagging SRE+Runtime here; drop trace ids and we'll triage. Example traces: trace-2026-12-15-09, trace-2026-12-15-11.
deploy-bot: deployment queued: runtime/kernel-autotune-proto -> canary group alpha (job 11577) :rocket:
Kavya Rao: Recap actions: I'll post YAML + rollout checklist; Runtime to publish eviction doc + kernel spans; SRE+Runtime to triage hang traces; Arjun to run local latency_budget tests. Ping here if anything missing.
Arjun Mehta: I'll post my local test snippet to #eng-runtime later today.
Claire Wu: thanks all :thumbsup:
